Celebrity Ads for Prediction Markets Draw Criticism

Celebrity endorsements for prediction market platforms, including those featuring Sydney Sweeney and LeBron James, have generated criticism. The ads have sparked backlash from critics who liken these platforms to gambling. Fortune reported that prediction markets are investing heavily in celebrity campaigns despite the controversy. The Wall Street Journal noted Sydney Sweeney's star power being used to promote a prediction market. Fox News highlighted Sydney Sweeney in a provocative new campaign, without detailing the platform.
